gen-dafont-origami-outfit: Outfit bends its curves like cable, stopping well before they close, with no swelling or thinning anywhere along the line. Origami earns its keep big and brief, brushy and heavy as poured lead.
gen-dafont-origami-plus-jakarta-sans: A sign-painter's single-stroke brush line gives Origami its swagger, with a lowercase massed like poured lead type. Plus Jakarta Sans does the precise, monoline talking where Origami just announces.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-fs-chillax: Synthwave swagger: Outrun Future traces wide-set letters in a constant outline, large x-height, short ascenders. Chillax loosens things up, its spaghetti-like line leaving loops unfinished beneath the heading.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-fs-plein: Synthwave with a ruler: Outrun Future makes the loudest statement, letters spaced wide in a constant outline. Plein handles the steadier work, with a clear channel leading into every round letter.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-fs-roundo: Roundo keeps every small counter unclogged, with a lowercase n whose arch and stem match. But Outrun Future is the one to shout, wide-set and outlined at constant width.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-fs-spline-sans: Retro-future attitude: Outrun Future spaces its letters wide and traces them in a constant outline. Spline Sans reads smoothly across paragraphs, wide gaps between curve ends and stems keeping the text open.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-fs-synonym: A constant-width outline you could trace with a finger defines Outrun Future. Synonym backs it up with a plain stripe of constant ink and generous openings, so the loud heading never fights the text.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-almendra: Almendra reads dignified and bookish, its deep midsection giving lowercase a weighty, settled look. And paragraphs of it would feel unhurried, a world away from Outrun Future's single-width strokes.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-bree-serif: Literary and refined, Bree Serif carries the tone in oversized lowercase. Outrun Future handles the loud, hairline-free, shadow-free announcing, while Bree Serif does the patient work of carrying text.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-port-lligat-: Port Lligat Slab gives its lowercase wide, glass-porthole counters and open-ended curves. Port Lligat Slab keeps pages feeling literary and traditional, a steady foil to Outrun Future's bent-paperclip strokes.
